name: dsdv_mu_hwin
structural_change: MU-S81-2/HWIN 10-19: dsdv_mu_hwin restructured for timing on the SEQ RTL (5dd45e769, slot gap table, entries wrap at nw): one-hot table pointers (8 event rows, retire, slot, gap walker) instead of binary pe[e] (REFILL-0730 gate: pe[*][1] ~3.7k loads, 22-level ~895 ps pe -> 47:1 ts mux -> +D -> ==tm -> mu_c); per-event registered look-ahead heads {ts,pos,user,land,ab} with a freshness bit; tmd[e] = tm - D and tmr = tm - RL + 1 registered so fire / due are flop-to-flop 32-bit equalities; record staged one edge (rec_q); gap table stores gap-1; gate 2: head eq / late compares registered one edge ahead (eqn/ltn), fd unreset; std area 8,300 from gate 1's synthesis (8,257 um2, 61k cells, 7,585 flops; gate 1 WARN: reg->reg +0.9 ps on tmd->eq->col_w->t_wf, +15.9 ps tmd->eq->mu_c). Same ports, mu_c / mu_rc on the same edges (K 2 unchanged, zero added output cycles). Previous: REFILL-0730/HWIN NEW leaf (MU-S81-2/DIE ac336f805) beside the CLOSED dsdv_mu_hslot; faces W die-facing f_ks/mu_c/mu_rc/mu_rt, E f_mc/f_mw/t_wf, S ck/rst_n.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: f_ks / f_mc / f_mw / mu_rt land in pin flops (ks_q / mc_q / mw_q / rt_q), mu_c / mu_rc / t_wf leave flops (c_q / rc_q / t_wf).

job.purpose: MU-S81-2/HWIN: MU die end-slice window leaf dsdv_mu_hwin (NSLOT 47, NEV 8, timing-restructured) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).
